anika: Quick follow-up to the PM: three recurring signals — token timeouts during long gens, partial/truncated chunks, and reconnect failures under spike. Need owners + concise runbook items.

pete: I'll own reconnects. Plan: make stream resume idempotent, add jittered backoff, surface a short failure reason code. ETA: 2023-11-15.

aj: I'll own partial output telemetry. Will emit `stream.eos_received`, `stream.final_chunk_size_bytes`, and `stream.partial=true/false`, plus a Datadog panel. ETA: 2023-11-14.

maria: I'll run canaries for mobile/web and a network-throttle matrix (US/EU/APAC) to validate client resume and `Retry-After` behavior. ETA: 2023-11-16.

sam: I'll add route-level `token_timeout_ms` (default 30000) and override `/v1/streams/long-gen` to 90000 behind a feature flag. ETA: 2023-11-13.

anika: Concrete action list:
- pete: reconnect idempotency + backoff config 5 2023-11-15
- aj: metrics + dashboard + partial alert (page if >0.5% for 10m) 5 2023-11-14
- sam: token_timeout override feature-flagged deploy 5 2023-11-13
- maria: canary + throttling matrix across regions 5 2023-11-16

op-bot: deploybot: scheduled job `streaming/reconnect-2324` created, run id run-9001

anika: Ops checklist for rollout: update runtime, wire metrics, feature flag rollout, canary, 24h smoke tests, then promote. Weekly 15-min "streaming signal review" for 6 weeks.

pete: Draft runtime snippet I'll use in PR: `reconnect: {max_retries:5, base_backoff_ms:200, max_backoff_ms:5000, jitter: full, resume_header: X-Stream-Resume}`. Will include fuzz-disconnect tests.

aj: Dashboard link when ready: <https://dashboards.internal/d/streaming/partial-chunk>

support: SUP-4521 has customer reports of partial responses in last 90d; added to action tracker.

anmika: (typo) Sorry meant anika: Thanks all. I'll add these to the PM action tracker and create calendar invites for the weekly sync. Ping me if ETAs shift. :white_check_mark:
